newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lionda 1996 net profits at 29 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Lionda 1996 net profits at 29 mln yuan.

text.p: Shenzhen Lionda Holdings Co Ltd posted net profits of 28.58 million yuan in 1996, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said in an announcement after the market closed on Tuesday.
Earnings per share were 0.10 yuan in 1996 and turnover reached 467.50 million yuan, the exchange said.
It did not specify whether the results were compiled under Chinese or international accounting standards and gave no comparative figures.
For 1995, the company posted net profits of 8.25 million yuan based on international accounting standards.
Under Chinese standards, 1995 net profits were 20.13 million yuan for Lionda, which owns a brewery in Shenzhen.
The firm proposed no dividend for 1996, the exchange said.
Trading in the company's A and B shares will be suspended on Wednesday morning and will resume in the afternoon, it said.
